market_story: Zero mechanism changes: the miso-64 keeper recipe verbatim on the REGENERATED >=5-day unit-outage extract (campd-unit-outages-MISO.csv, commit 7b5c26fd). The committed extract did not reproduce from its own frozen deriver on the committed CAMPD parquets: re-running (guards/constants untouched) emits 1,655 windows it lacked (+~1,550 GW-days in EACH of 2023/2024/2025), among them seven >=5-day July-2025 North coal sustained full stops at span-CF<0.002 (Ottumwa, Gibson-3, Labadie-2, Baldwin-2, Cayuga-1/2, Sioux-1); July North-coal outage coverage rises 2.75->4.00 GW mean. Lane 3 (docs/FINDING-miso-lane3-north-supply-2026-07.md): the stale file left the model's July North coal shelf ~1.3-1.7 GW too deep every year. Scored effect vs the keeper: C3b price-shape FAIL->PASS (fail set sheds one: now {fuelmix, price_mean, price_tail}); C3a-2025 -15.4%->-12.9%; 2023 COAL_PRB clears (-8.47->in-band) and 2024 PRB narrows -12.41->-10.53; ST_GAS forced share collapses 35.5%->~12% (C8 passes clean, no grounded escalation needed — honest availability replaces forcing); C1 holds 14/16 all / 10/12 free. Honest cost: 2024 CT_PEAKER flips FAIL (+5.1->+8.38 TWh) — at $2.19 gas the LP fills the removed phantom coal with CT, where the real market self-committed coal (SOM Table 7: 53-56% of regulated-coal starts self-commit) — the availability truth EXPOSES the lane-1 conduct gap the stale extract was silently compensating (rule 15). July-2025 Indiana +0.4 only: the remaining July gap is owned by the lane-2 max-gen event registry, lane-1 conduct, and C3c scarcity depth (FINDING §5). [Re-solved 2026-07-14 on the G-A1 gas_daily_shape mean-preservation fix (calendar-day factors renormalized to mean exactly 1.0, commit 9037c89); determination and all 12 criterion verdicts unchanged (metrics.json byte-identical). Per-class figures above re-derived from this re-solve: most hold to the decimal (C3a-2025 -12.9%, C1 14/16 all / 10/12 free, 2023 COAL_PRB in-band); the low-gas 2024 year nudged as the mean-preserving fix marginally rebalanced its coal/gas margin (COAL_PRB -10.41->-10.53, CT_PEAKER +8.30->+8.38 TWh), both still FAIL.
